claim: For integers \(k\ge2\), \(n\ge1\), \(r\ge0\), equip the finite Gödel power \(C_k^n\) with coordinatewise bounded Heyting operations and global monadic quantifiers \(\forall f=\overline{\min_i f(i)}\), \(\exists f=\overline{\max_i f(i)}\). An ordered \(r\)-tuple of vectors generates the entire algebra if and only if all \(n\) positivity-code vectors \((\mathbf1_{\{g_j(i)>0\}})_{j=1}^r\) are distinct and every intermediate truth value of the chain appears among the tuple entries. The exact ordered generator-tuple count is \(N_{k,n,r}=n!\sum_{h=0}^{k-2}(-1)^h\binom{k-2}{h}[z^n]\prod_{j=0}^r(1+z(k-1-h)^j)^{\binom rj}\), with \(0^0=1\). If \(T_r(n)\) denotes the sum of the \(n\) largest Hamming weights of pairwise distinct binary words of length \(r\), with \(T_r(n)=-\infty\) for \(n>2^r\), then \(d(C_k^n)=\min\{r\ge0:n\le2^r,\ k-2\le T_r(n)\}\). This includes the Boolean case \(N_{2,n,r}=(2^r)_n\) and provides exact finite rank transitions.

correctness.rationale: The term-value invariant follows since all primitive operations select a preexisting input value or endpoint, including global min/max. The Boolean zero-set invariant follows from Z(a→b)=Z(b)\Z(a), lattice zero-set laws and constant global quantifiers. Crisp negation masks build coordinate selectors from pairwise distinct positivity codes. Global max of selector-meets extracts every represented chain value diagonally, and masked joins reconstruct arbitrary vectors. Inclusion-exclusion and maximum Hamming weight prove the exact census and minimal rank. Actual independent closure verification passed 8800 cases; its finite scope is not used as an infinite proof.

title: Exact generator rank and census for finite monadic Gödel powers

value.rationale: The exact minimal number of generators and ordered generating-tuple count are natural structural invariants for finite monadic Gödel powers. The simultaneous Hamming-code separation and surjective truth-level coverage constraints explain two distinct obstructions and yield an explicit sharp optimization, not merely a relabeling of known free-chain counts. The Boolean specialization is recovered exactly.
